comms_plan.message: Canary starts Jan 5 for employees only; no customer-facing change expected.
Opt-in early access opens Jan 12; v2 playback starts faster, no action needed.
Playback API v2 rolls out to everyone Jan 19; v1 stays available until Feb 28.

rollback_criteria: Error rate exceeds 1% for 15 consecutive minutes.
p95 playback-start latency rises more than 20% over the v1 baseline.
Any Sev-1 or Sev-2 incident attributed to v2 during a phase.
